title: Glean tool server v0.2: front door, public mode, hosted HTTP
creator: Timmy Gack
ai_assist: Claude (Anthropic, Opus 5.5): do/call front door, public/local modes, Streamable HTTP transport, Dockerfile, tests
notes: Step toward one URL anyone adds to their AI. do(request) finds the right tool from plain words (everyday-word map, honest 'nothing does that yet'); call(name, arguments) runs any tool; --front-door lists only do/call/what_can_you_do so the commons can grow to thousands of cells. --public exposes only tools marked stateless (holds no one's data) and still points people to local-only tools. Stdlib Streamable HTTP (POST /mcp, origin checks, health) and a Dockerfile; refuses to expose private books on a network address. Fixes search_cells passing the wrong shape to search.py, and a lock deadlock found by the new tests. Not yet hosted anywhere. uses=0.
